entries.scope: Formula recalculation and spreadsheet JSON loading resource boundaries
entries.rationale: The security fix introduces observable fail-safe limits for JSON bytes, JSON depth, and formula-reference work while preserving valid saved sheets and per-run recalculation semantics.
readerPaths: README interaction contract -> migrated help -> runtime help
Threat model -> GSDB open finding -> focused regression tests
entries.navigationImpact: Existing README, help, and security-document paths are updated; no new navigation surface is introduced.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second at CEFR B2; runtime help keeps matching German and English pages.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Focused Core tests cover oversized and deeply nested JSON, maximum application-generated sheets, forward-compatible unknown fields, repeated-reference DAGs, work-budget exhaustion, cycles, and dependency refresh.
entries.risk: Low residual risk: valid application-generated sheets remain loadable; small unknown JSON fields remain allowed; broader filesystem error-message handling is explicitly out of scope.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Grid dimensions, cell-input limits, JSON format, formula grammar, public evaluator contract, or load error handling changes.
